title: Prompt Comparison
prompt:
Compare at least two prompts against the same synthetic test set and score format compliance, relevance, evidence, and failure cases using a fixed rubric.

Submit a concise report or a small, inspectable implementation. Include what you tested, what you observed, and one limitation. The server-side grader checks required terms only; the full-quality rubric still requires human review.

starter.starter:
# Exercise 8: Prompt Comparison
# State your approach, evidence, and limitations.

public_tests.name: Required evidence present
public_tests.note: The automatic keyword check is a basic submission gate, not a measure of technical correctness.

acceptance_criteria: Address the scenario and name the method or evidence used.
Provide the requested output, calculation, workflow, or implementation outline.
Record at least one assumption, failure mode, or limitation and how it was checked.
hints: Record failed cases rather than cherry-picking good outputs.
Use synthetic data only and keep the test cases fixed when comparing approaches.

retry_policy.guidance: Use feedback to revise the work. Completion should reflect a correct submission; repeated submissions must not create duplicate platform rewards.

expected_output: A reproducible result or report that satisfies the acceptance criteria and states important limitations.
